text:
Ravi: Starting intake for a new model bring-up: pb-3b-v2 (we're planning 4-bit quant + act-order). Need a concise checklist for prompt formatting + API integration: chat template, tool-calling hooks, and structured-output schema. Also want canary plan and quick evals.

Anya: +1. I'll sketch a minimal checklist. Keep prompts deterministic for evals, use function/tool contracts for non-deterministic ops, and require a JSON schema for any structured outputs. Emoji: :white_check_mark:

Luis: Quick note on quant: 4-bit LLMQ usually slightly changes tokenization behavior for long contexts. For prompts, prefer explicit delimiters and short system messages to reduce prefix noise.

Marta: Proposed checklist (short):
1) Define chat template (system + user + examples) and pin to model config.
2) Define response schema (JSON Schema) and a strict validator in the ingestion layer.
3) Tool spec: name, args schema, sync/async flag, auth.
4) Canary plan: 1% traffic -> smoke eval -> 10% -> perf/regression check -> full rollout.
5) Quant test: perf, memory, tokenization regression suite.
6) Integration tests: streaming, partial JSON, tool call fallback.

Ravi: Can you paste an exemplar chat template + tool-call snippet we can copy into the onboarding doc?

Anya: Here — copyable example (keep it small):

```
System: You are Redwood Assistant specialized for customer support. Reply concisely and return structured output when asked.
User: {{user_query}}
---
# Response contract (always return JSON blob under `structured_output` when `intent == \"action\"`)
{
  "structured_output": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "answer": {"type": "string"},
      "action": {"type": ["null","object"]},
      "confidence": {"type": "number"}
    },
    "required": ["answer"]
  }
}
```

Anya: Tool calling example for API integration:

```
# Tool manifest (server-side)
- name: fetch_invoice
  args_schema: {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {"invoice_id":{"type":"string"}},
    "required":["invoice_id"]
  }
  sync: true
```

Ravi: How do we handle partial/streamed JSON from the model (common with streaming)?

Luis: Two options: 1) Server-side streaming + incremental JSON assembly with tolerant parser (accept trailing commas, + re-try on parse error) but validate final blob; 2) Prefer non-streamed contract for critical tool calls: model returns a tool call object, then server invokes tool synchronously and streams human-friendly text separately.

Marta: Add these integration rules to the checklist:
- Prefer explicit `TOOL_CALL_START/END` tokens in templates for streaming detectability.
- If structured output is critical, enforce a single-turn non-streamed call in canary.
- Add end-to-end eval: prompt -> model -> tool -> final user message.

ops-bot: Reminder: create canary route in Redwood Router: `model=pb-3b-v2;percentage=1;fallback=pb-3b-v1`. See /infra/canaries runbook.

Ravi: Nice. Last items: evaluation harness (what metrics?) and prompt regression checks to gate rollout.

Anya: Metrics: schema compliance %, tool-call accuracy, exact-match on scalar fields (IDs), BLEU/EM for short answers, latency p50/p95, token cost delta vs baseline, hallucination rate on defined probes. Add automatic alert if schema compliance drops >2% vs baseline.

Luis: For quantization experiments: add side-by-side comparisons with unquantized checkpoints on the same eval set and seed. Save tokenizers+vocab checkpoints. Also record per-layer quant noise stats.

Marta: I'll put this into the onboarding PR template: short checklist, chat/template snippets, tool manifest example, JSON Schema example, canary routing snippet, and eval metrics table. Will open PR and tag @Ravi @Luis for review. :rocket:

Ravi: Perfect — thanks everyone. Assigning follow-ups: @Marta create PR; @Anya produce 5 deterministic eval prompts; @Luis run quant regression bench and upload logs. I'll coordinate canary route with infra.

Marta: Roger. I'll include a small 'integration smoke' script example too (curl + validator).

Ravi: End of thread — keeping this as the onboarding seed for pb-3b-v2.
